note: 此刻那一本主线节点原画的场面稿，头一轮（每条主线一幅）上半：#1165 到 #1184。键 n<卡里序号>_<第几幕>，line 是主线名（跟 src/road_text.json 一字不差），act 是 一幕 到 四幕。格式照山铜纪 scenes/派活说明.md。

nodes.name: 星印
who: the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf
nodes.light: warm amber gas-lamp light from a single street lamp high on the right, against deep blue night shadow, with one cold white beam of a far lighthouse crossing the sky
nodes.camera: low, from just behind the shoulders of three men who stand with their backs to us in the near foreground, looking between them at the two girls; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep night in a steep back alley of the lower ring of a vast city built around the mouth of an enormous pit; shacks and stairways climb toward the rim, and far above the rooftops the cold white beam of a great lighthouse sweeps across the sky. In the near foreground three black-market brokers stand with their backs to us, seen directly from behind and cut off at the shoulders by the frame: long dark coats, one flat cap, one hand holding a small purse. Between them, in the middle of the picture and facing us, stands the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf: eighteen, warm dark brown hair in a high messy ponytail, big amber eyes, a fitted dark grey hooded jacket. She has planted herself in front of them with both arms spread wide to the sides, palms open, chin up, jaw set, refusing to move. One step behind her and a little to the right, also facing us, stands a small girl who looks fifteen: damp silver hair cut at the shoulders, wide mist-blue eyes with very large pupils, an old adult traveller's cloak far too big for her with the sleeves rolled up three times. With both hands she holds a worn star-shaped bronze seal pressed against her chest; she looks straight at us, quiet and unafraid. Behind the two girls the alley ends at a low stone arch through which pale mist creeps along the ground. Moths and motes of lamp light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：露希亚在下城露面，黑市掮客围住她，米娅挡在前头。掮客只画背影。露希亚看上去十五六，照未成年画，不带伤。

nodes.name: 耳语
who: the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat
nodes.light: a soft golden glow that comes from the standing spirit itself in the middle, against cold blue-black shadow in the vault, with thin dusty shafts of pale light from cracks far above
nodes.camera: low and wide from the floor of the vault behind the knight, looking up a broad flight of worn steps at the spirit before the sealed gate; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a colossal burial vault of a kingdom dead for fifteen thousand years, deep under a living city; pillars carved as rising suns vanish into the dark, and thick roots and dust hang from the ceiling. At the top of a broad flight of worn steps stands a tall sealed stone gate carved with a great sun disc. Before the gate, in the middle of the picture and facing us, stands the spirit of a young prince, twice the height of a man and half transparent, made of soft golden light: ancient plate armour of a forgotten make, a round sun-shield on his back, short pale hair, a calm young face with closed eyes. Both his hands rest on the pommel of a great sword planted point-down on the top step; he stands like a sentry who has never left his post. At his far shoulder, leaning close to his ear in full profile, is a skeleton in the long dusty robe of a royal chancellor, bone white, with a heavy square state seal grey with dust hanging on a chain on its chest; one bony hand is raised beside its jaw as it whispers. On the steps below them two ranks of ancient royal guards, empty suits of old armour with a faint glow inside, stand facing outward with spears grounded. In the near foreground at the foot of the steps, small against all this, the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat stands seen directly from behind, her right hand on the hilt of her sheathed sword, her left hand hanging open at her side. Golden dust motes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：旧王陵里亡国近卫守着阿德里安的英灵，死灵大公贴在他耳边低语。大公照卡里写成披宰相长袍、挂蒙灰国玺的白骨，不报名。王子的样子卡里没写，补成古甲、圆盾、闭着眼守门。

nodes.name: 入梦
who: the violet-haired mage in the black and white robe
nodes.light: soft green-gold lantern light from festival lanterns on the left, against the deep blue-green dark of a night forest, with faint pale glow rising from the roots
nodes.camera: low and close, level with the sleeping princess, looking slightly up so that the trunk behind her fills the whole background; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in an elven court built among the roots of a tree as large as a mountain; the trunk fills the whole background like a wall of bark and is cut off by the frame on every side, and strings of small festival lanterns hang between the roots. The fight is just over: here and there on the moss lie the remains of beasts made of black vines, wolf-shaped tangles of dark briar already falling apart into loose stems. In the middle, the silver-haired elf princess sits propped against a great root, facing us, fast asleep: long straight silver-white hair, long pointed ears, a pale silver-green court gown with long sleeves, a thin leaf circlet on her brow. Her eyes are closed, her head is tilted a little toward her right shoulder, and both her hands lie open in her lap; a short hunting bow, unstrung, lies on the moss beside her. A few thin living green tendrils have curled gently around her wrists and into her hair, like a hand laid on a sleeper, and a faint pale-green light runs from them up into the bark behind her. On the left, kneeling beside her in full profile facing right, is the violet-haired mage in the black and white robe: long straight violet hair, a calm young face drawn tight with worry. Her right hand holds a small disc of white testing light just above the princess's forehead; her left hand holds her long staff upright with its foot on the moss. Tiny pale spores and lantern sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①收在她睡过去那一下：打退黑藤兽以后世界树把希露菲拉进梦里，菲伦验毒。画的是静的一幅。月鹿祭不写月字，写成节灯。

nodes.name: 卵中心跳
nodes.light: a cold silver-blue pulse of light that comes from the bundle in the girl's arms, against the grey-white dark of a blizzard, with a dim steel-blue sky
nodes.camera: low, from the snow just behind and to the left of the warrior, looking past her at the kneeling girl and up at the ridge; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a blizzard on a high snowfield just after an avalanche; broken slabs of snow and uprooted pines lie everywhere. Across the whole background runs a jagged mountain ridge shaped like the spine of a sleeping dragon, cut off by the frame at both sides, and all along it snow is shaking loose and sliding at once, as if the ridge had shuddered. In the middle, kneeling in the snow and facing us, is a tall young dragonkin woman of eighteen: rough wind-blown white hair, fine grey-blue scales at her temples, down the sides of her neck and on the backs of her hands, a heavy hooded fur coat. With both arms she hugs to her chest a large egg wrapped in a coarse grey wool blanket; from inside the blanket a silver-blue light pulses, and rings of that light spread outward across the snow around her like ripples. She looks down at the bundle with her lips parted in wonder. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, stands the tall silver-haired northern warrior: shaggy silver-white hair past the shoulders, a dark navy riveted leather field coat with a fur collar, an iron pauldron. She stands between us and the girl with her feet planted wide and her great weapon held low in both hands. Far beyond the kneeling girl, small in the driving snow at the foot of the ridge, loom the grey silhouettes of three frost giants with a pack of white wolves at their knees. Snowflakes streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：雪崩过后救出莱茵娜，有人走近，龙卵里响起心跳，龙眠天脊震了一震。莱茵娜十八岁，没立绘，照任务人物那一条写。追兵画成远处的影子。

nodes.name: 末班车
who: the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat
nodes.light: a hard violet-white glow from a key set in the front of the locomotive on the left, against black fog and deep crimson shadow, with small cold lamps along the platform
nodes.camera: low on the platform, close behind the princess's side, looking along the rails into the fog at the huge front of the locomotive; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a platform of the great underground terminus of a black obsidian capital; iron arches and rows of cold lamps run off into the dark. Thick black fog rolls out of the tunnel mouth on the left and over the rails, and out of it stands the front of an enormous armoured locomotive, stopped, its plates scorched, far taller than a house and cut off by the top of the frame. Set into the middle of its iron prow, like a jewel, is a large old city key that burns with violet-white light. Behind the engine the carriage windows glow dimly, and on the inside of the glass there are only pale handprints and the faint outlines of passengers with no faces. Out of the fog beside the engine leap three beasts made of empty black armour plates, hound-shaped and hollow, with red light in the joints. On the right, in the foreground, the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat stands in full profile facing left toward the engine: long wine-red hair, two small curved black horns half hidden in it, large ruby eyes narrowed, a fitted black coat with a wine-red lining and a row of small gold clasps. Her right arm is stretched straight out toward the burning key, fingers spread, and a thin ring of red contract-script light without readable letters turns in front of her palm; her left hand is closed at her side. On the platform at her feet lies one dropped travelling case, burst open. Shreds of black fog and red sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：烬灭站台，魔铠兽从黑雾里冲出来，车头上嵌着头一把城市钥匙，车厢里只剩没有名字的求救声。没有脸的乘客画成玻璃上的手印。地方参考用渊月总站那一张。

nodes.name: 白螺号
nodes.light: cold pale blue-green lantern light from the ghost ships out in the fog, against the warm amber lamps of the harbour behind us and a grey sky just before dawn
nodes.camera: from the end of a stone pier at the height of the two people standing on it, looking out over the water at the ring of ships; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the hour before dawn at the mouth of a great harbour, thick sea fog on still water. Out of the fog, in a wide ring that closes the whole harbour mouth from one edge of the picture to the other, has risen a fleet of sunken ships: dozens of wrecks with barnacled hulls, broken masts and torn pale sails, water still streaming from their gun ports, each hung with pale blue-green lanterns. They do not fire and do not move; they simply stand there. In the middle of the ring towers the flagship, a huge white wreck whose bow ends in a great spiral conch shell, cut off by the top of the frame. On its bow, small and far, stands the ghost admiral: a tall drowned-pale man in an old long admiral's coat, facing us, standing straight with both hands clasped behind his back. In the near foreground at the end of the stone pier stand two people. On the left, seen directly from behind, the tall silver-haired northern warrior in a dark navy riveted leather coat with a fur collar, her great weapon resting head-down on the stones with both hands on its haft. On the right, in full profile facing left toward the ships, a young woman of twenty with long blue-black hair stiff with salt and tied back with a piece of rope, wind-reddened cheeks, a dock worker's canvas coat; her right hand is closed around a small sea-conch that hangs on a worn cord at her throat, her left hand hangs at her side with a small wax writing tablet tied to the wrist. Wisps of fog and drops of spray drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：埃斯卡隆的沉船军团围住银帆，什么也不抢。旗舰白螺号，船首画成一只大海螺。诺雅二十岁，失声，海螺挂在喉咙前。仗还没打，画的是对峙。

nodes.name: 星砂指针
nodes.light: a blinding white-gold glare from the fallen star on the upper left, throwing hard light and long shadows across the wall, against the blue-black dark of the pit
nodes.camera: from a narrow ledge on the inner wall of the pit, close to the kneeling archer and level with her hands, looking up along the curving wall toward the star; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the inner wall of an enormous pit, a well wide enough to hold a city, its far side lost in darkness; tiers of stone cornices, stairs and rope bridges ring the wall. High above the pit hangs a great thin ring of small stars of light, and in that ring there is one dark gap. On the upper left, half sunk into the stone of a cornice on the second tier, lies the fallen star: a jagged ball of white-gold crystal the size of a house, so bright that the rock around it is washed white. Small dark figures of men hang on ropes around it and are throwing heavy iron chains over it. In the foreground on the right, on a narrow ledge, a small young woman of twenty kneels facing us: an archer with short unevenly cut sand-blonde hair, a patched leather jerkin over a long-sleeved shirt, worn leather guards on three fingers of her left hand, and on her back a hunting bow whose upper limb is snapped off, bound with strips of cloth. A rescue rope is still knotted round her waist. She holds her left hand open, palm up, at the height of her chest; in the palm a pinch of glittering star-sand has drawn itself together into a thin bright needle that floats just above her skin and points sideways toward the left edge of the picture. Her right hand is braced flat on the ledge. Her eyes follow the needle. On the wall at the left, where the needle points, gapes a freshly cut round hole, rubble still spilling from its lip. Grains of bright sand and motes of light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：环星嵌在井壁第二层檐口，马洛里的人往星上套铁链。菲雅刚叫人拉上来，掌心的星砂聚成指针，指着横里刚凿开的洞口。头发的颜色卡里没写，补成沙金。画里那张断了上梢的弓背着不用。

nodes.name: 金羽
nodes.light: low golden dawn sun from the right behind the towers, with long cool blue shadows across the roofs and a pale clear sky
nodes.camera: at roof height, close in front of the young squire and a little below her, looking back along the ridge of the roofs toward the white palace; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn over the rooftops of a white and gold imperial capital; tiled roofs, chimneys and bell towers step away toward a pale palace on a height. A trail of large golden feathers lies scattered along the roof ridges, catching the sun one after another, and far away on the right the trail ends at a round stone drain mouth in the foot of the palace wall. In the middle, on the ridge of the nearest roof and facing us, stands a young squire of eighteen who has just stopped running: short wheat-coloured hair, a streak of sweat wiped across one cheek, a plain trainee's half-plate breastplate and pauldrons a size too wide for her shoulders over a quilted long-sleeved jacket, a short sword at her hip, and one golden feather tucked into her belt. Her right hand is stretched up above her head and has just closed on another golden feather drifting down out of the air; her left hand is braced on a brick chimney beside her. She looks up at the feather, breathing hard, her face earnest and stubborn. On the left, standing on a lower roof in full profile facing right, is the golden-haired knight on leave: thick wavy warm-gold hair, sea-blue eyes, plain off-duty clothes with a long coat, a sheathed sword at her hip, her left hand resting on its pommel and her right hand shading her eyes as she looks along the trail toward the drain. On a far roof two small dark figures of thieves with grappling claws are slipping away with a pair of lean hounds. Flecks of gold down and chimney smoke drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：卡萝顺着屋顶上的金羽追，金羽到皇城排水口就断了。卡萝十八岁，腰带上别着一根金羽。埃莉诺在休假，穿常服。地方参考用金鸢城全景。

nodes.name: 银火
who: the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet
nodes.light: a pure silver-white light from the flame in the young nun's hands in the middle, whiter than candlelight, against a violet dusk sky and deep blue shadow under the gate
nodes.camera: from above and behind the swooping stone creatures, looking down past a blurred stone wing at the people under the gate arch; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk under the towering gate arch of a holy city of white stone and star-topped spires. A column of pilgrims in travel cloaks, with staffs and small bundles, has crowded back against the gate wall. Stone gargoyles, grey winged statues come alive, are swooping down on them from the cornices; two of them fill the upper near corners of the picture, blurred and close. In the middle, between the pilgrims and the gargoyles and facing us, stands a young nun of nineteen: short flax-coloured hair tucked under a white veil with a few strands escaping, pale blue eyes, a plain long-sleeved habit whose cuffs are scorch-marked yet whole. She holds both hands cupped together in front of her chest, and in them burns a silver-white flame the size of a lamp; it throws clean white light over every face and casts hard black shadows, and where the light touches the nearest gargoyle its stone is cracking and flaking and it recoils with its claws thrown up. She looks at her own hands with her eyes wide, more astonished than anyone. On the left, in full profile facing right, the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet stands with her left arm stretched back to shelter a small pilgrim child behind her, and her right hand raised holding her staff upright; soft golden hair past her shoulders, amber eyes fixed on the flame. White sparks and stone dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：石像鬼截住朝圣队，安洁掌心亮起银白的火。火不烫，照人比蜡烛还白。审判（第二天当众摘头巾）没画，留给后头补。

nodes.name: 泉坛
nodes.light: cold silver light rising in threads from the great stag on the altar in the middle, against the black-green dark of an ancient forest and a faint sickly amber glow from the spider's eyes
nodes.camera: low, from the edge of the pool just behind the ranger's shoulder, looking across the water and up at the altar and the huge shape arched over it; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep night in a forbidden grove of gigantic trees hung with grey spider silk. In a clearing lies a round spring pool, and in its middle a low island of white stone with an old altar. On the altar lies a great white stag, far larger than any horse, its many-branched silver antlers spread like two bare winter trees; grey silk binds its legs, its head is raised and it still strains against the bonds. From its body rise dozens of thin threads of silver light, pulled sideways through the air. At the head of the altar, on the right, in full profile facing left, stands a gaunt old elf woman in a cloak of dead branches, bark and grey moss, her long hair dry and tangled like twigs, her face sharp and hungry; both her arms are raised and bent, hands open before her chest, and the threads of light are flowing into her. Arched over the whole altar behind them, cut off by the top and both sides of the frame, crouches a spider as big as a hall, black and bristled, its legs planted around the pool like the bars of a cage and its cluster of eyes glowing dull amber. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, a young wood-elf ranger stands at the edge of the pool: short deep-green hair, a small copper bell clipped to the tip of one pointed ear, worn leather armour with patched knees, a coil of red cord at her belt. She has a short bow fully drawn, the bow held out in her left hand toward the old woman and her right hand drawn back to her cheek. Loose strands of silk and silver motes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：月泉祭坛上枯枝女巫莫薇恩要把月鹿王的命吸进自己身子，巨蛛王盘在她身后。月字都不写，月鹿王写成大白鹿，枝角写成两棵冬天的树。薇儿只画背影。

nodes.name: 砧上火
who: the dark-haired mage in the red coat with twin tails
nodes.light: white-orange furnace glare from the right, with a redder, darker glow of molten rock from the left, and deep brown-black shadow between them
nodes.camera: low, at the height of the anvil, from a little in front of it, with the furnace mouth on the right and the broken gate on the left; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside the royal furnace hall of a dwarven city under a mountain: a vault of black stone and brass pipes, and on the right the mouth of the great king-furnace, three storeys tall, blazing white-orange. On the far left the hall's iron gate has just been smashed inward, and through the breach reaches the arm and shoulder of a giant made of cooling lava, black crust split by glowing red seams, its hand as big as a wagon, molten rock dripping from its fingers; the rest of it is cut off by the frame. In the middle left, seen directly from behind, stands the dark-haired mage in the red coat with twin tails: both her arms are stretched straight forward toward the giant with the palms open, and between her and the giant's hand stands a tall curved wall of ruby-red light made of six-sided panes; lava spatters against it and runs down. On the right of the middle, at a great anvil in front of the furnace, in full profile facing right toward the fire, stands a young dwarf smith, a short sturdy woman about one hundred and thirty centimetres tall: red-brown braids tucked into a high leather collar, the outer half of her left eyebrow burnt away, a heavy leather apron, bare forearms crossed with old burn scars. Her left hand holds long tongs that grip a white-hot unfinished sword blade flat on the anvil; her right hand has raised a smith's hammer above her shoulder, about to strike. Her face is calm and set; she does not look round at the giant. A stub of chalk and three chalk ticks, plain strokes, mark the side of the anvil. Sparks and flakes of hot scale fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：熔岩巨人攻进炉心，一边守炉一边锻剑。布琳是矮人，砧边三道粉笔记号是她记那三样材料的。凛在前头撑着护壁。

nodes.name: 脚背
who: the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat
nodes.light: hard late-afternoon sun from the left through clouds of yellow dust, with warm brown shadow under the machine and glints on brass
nodes.camera: very low, almost on the ground beside the giant iron foot, looking steeply up the leg at the machine and the factory on its back; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late afternoon at a quarry town on the edge of a roaring cliff. An ancient digging machine as tall as a cathedral has stood up on two colossal iron legs and is walking; it fills the whole picture and is cut off by the top and the right side of the frame. On its back it carries an entire assembly works: sheds, chimneys still smoking, cranes and catwalks hanging loose, pipes snapping. From its body sprout dozens of jointed mechanical arms, and several of them hold small struggling workers high in the air by their coats. Dust and broken rail tracks spill from under its feet. In the foreground its nearest foot, a riveted iron slab as big as a house, has just come down on the ground. On top of that foot, facing us, stands a young dwarf engineer, a short sturdy woman about one hundred and thirty centimetres tall: short braids, brass goggles pushed up on her forehead, a smear of black oil across one cheek, patched work overalls with the handle of a wrench sticking out of a pocket, and a large iron key on a chain round her neck. Her left hand grips a rivet-studded pipe on the machine's ankle; her right arm points straight out to her right side, toward where the next step will land. Her mouth is open in a shout and her eyes are bright and sure. On the ground at the lower left, seen directly from behind and small, the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat stands looking up at her, long straight crimson hair blown sideways, one hand raised to shield her face from the dust. Grit and flying bolts streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：机神背着整座装配厂朝崖边走，机械臂抓着工人。露姆跳上脚背，说她看得出它下一步落在哪儿。露姆是矮人。

nodes.name: 怀中灯
who: the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf
nodes.light: a soft white glow from the lamp hugged in the fox-eared girl's arms, lighting her face from below, against warm orange festival lanterns and a sky gone suddenly black
nodes.camera: very low, from under the awning of a food cart, looking up at the girl as she ducks out toward us; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the night of a harvest mead festival in a market of tents among rolling hills: striped tents, food carts, a small wooden stage, strings of small orange glass lanterns, barrels and benches. A moment ago the whole sky went dark, and the crowd in the background is looking up and pointing. In the middle, ducking out from under the canvas awning of a food cart straight toward us, comes a beast-eared fox girl of sixteen: russet hair, two fox ears on top of her head, the left one upright and the right one flopped over, a bushy fox tail whose very tip is bare, plain market clothes with long loose sleeves. She hugs to her chest with both arms a glowing lamp, a globe of soft white light inside a cage of brass filigree, nearly as wide as her shoulders, and she holds it steady by pressing her chin down on top of it. Her eyes are wide and determined, her mouth pressed shut. Behind her on the right, two turns of the lane back, the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf is seen in full profile facing left, running after her: warm dark brown ponytail flying, a dark grey hooded jacket, her right arm stretched forward and her left arm swung back. Over the tops of the tents in the background leap three wolves made of black smoke with pale eyes, clear of everyone and far from the girl. A dropped honey cake and a rolling cup lie on the trampled grass. Lantern sparks and flecks of white light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：蜜酒祭那一夜天暗了，铃铃抱着灯钻过帐篷和餐车，米娅在后头追。月灯不写月字，写成铜丝笼里一团白光。铃铃十六岁，照未成年画，魔狼离她远。

nodes.name: 不进之厢
who: the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat
nodes.light: streaks of cold white lamp light racing past the windows on the right, with warm red-gold carriage lamps overhead and a thin violet glow from the bound sword
nodes.camera: at chest height in the aisle, close behind the princess's left shoulder, looking down the length of the swaying carriage at the masked man; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night inside a carriage of an armoured express train running at full speed through a black capital: a narrow aisle between rows of red velvet seats, brass luggage racks, riveted iron ribs along the ceiling, and outside the windows on the right, lamps and girders flashing past in long streaks. In the middle of the aisle, facing us, stands a young swordsman in plain black travelling clothes buttoned to the neck. A white mask with black markings covers his whole face down to the jaw. His right hand, wrapped in worn and fraying strips of old cloth, grips the hilt of a long black sword bound round with iron bands and wax seals, from under which a thin violet light leaks; he holds it low at his right side with the point toward the floor. His left hand hangs open and empty. He stands perfectly still and balanced in the swaying car. Behind him, at the far end of the carriage, a group of ordinary passengers, a mother, an old man, two clerks, sit crowded together in the last seats, frightened and unharmed, and the door to the next carriage behind them is shut: he has not gone that way. On the floor of the aisle between him and us lie an empty black helmet and the fallen brass body of a carriage-attendant automaton with one arm still twitching. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, stands the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat, long wine-red hair down her back and two small black horns; her left hand is raised to shoulder height, palm out toward him, and her right hand is at her side. Dust motes and flecks of lamp light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：鬼面剑客只抢了封印魔剑，有乘客的车厢一节也不进，平民一个没伤。右手缠着磨破的旧布。面具白底黑纹遮到下颌。

nodes.name: 城头齐射
who: the red-haired dragonkin champion in black plate with a tattered crimson cape
nodes.light: red-orange fire glare from the dragon and the volcano above, crossed by blue-white flashes from the cannons on the wall, against a sky black with ash
nodes.camera: low, from a tower top just behind the champion, looking up over the battlements at the dragon that fills the sky; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night over a fortress city of black basalt built on the flank of an erupting volcano; rivers of lava run down the mountain behind it and the sky is full of ash. Above the city, filling the whole upper half of the picture and cut off by the frame on both sides, hangs a colossal red-scaled mother dragon, a heavy Western wyrm with vast bat-like wings spread wide, her jaws open in a roar and fire curling from between her teeth. In the middle of her chest, showing through the scales, burns a knot of darker, wrong-coloured fire, crimson-black with a violet edge, unlike the clean orange of her own flame. Along the top of the city wall on the right runs a whole row of great arcane siege cannons, long bronze barrels ringed with glowing blue runes, and every one of them has just fired: a rank of blue-white bolts is streaking up at her and bursting against her wings. On the wall beside the first cannon stands a small figure of a broad horned master smith in a leather apron, in full profile, his right arm flung down in the signal to fire. In the near foreground on the left, on the top of a tower, seen directly from behind, stands the red-haired dragonkin champion in black plate with a tattered crimson cape: huge and broad-shouldered, short dark-red hair with two small horn-like ridges, the cape whipping to the right. His right arm is raised high toward the dragon with the hand open, as if calling to her to stop; his left hand holds the shaft of his weapon upright beside him. Embers and flakes of ash streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：母龙飞到城上，总匠塞萨尔没等谁下令拉开整列屠龙炮。母龙心口那团火不全是她自己的，画成一团颜色不对的火。屠龙炮写成刻着符文的魔导炮。

nodes.name: 定舞
who: the dark-haired night-folk lady in the crimson and black gown
nodes.light: deep red light through tall windows on the right from a crimson night sky, with warm gold chandelier light from above and cold silver glints on the crossbow
nodes.camera: at waist height on the dance floor, close beside the huntress, looking across the frozen dancers down the length of the hall; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in the great ballroom of an old castle of the night folk: a marble floor, red velvet drapes, tall arched windows glowing deep red, crystal chandeliers. The ball has stopped in mid-turn. All through the hall dozens of guests in evening dress stand frozen in the positions of a waltz, in pairs, arms still raised, eyes open: thick rose briars with dark red blooms have grown up out of the floor and wound round their ankles, waists and wrists and hold them like statues. In the open middle of the floor four pairs of dancers are still turning: empty suits of ornate parade armour, with nothing inside the helmets, waltzing with each other. In the foreground on the left, in full profile facing right toward the armoured dancers, stands a young huntress of twenty: glossy black hair in a high ponytail, a silver ring in her right ear, a short dark hunter's cloak over a buttoned long-sleeved jacket and trousers, tall boots with a folded paper tucked into the top of one. She holds a silver crossbow levelled at shoulder height, her left hand under the stock and her right hand at the trigger; a row of small notches is cut along the arm of the crossbow. Her face is cold and steady. One pace behind her, facing us, stands the dark-haired night-folk lady in the crimson and black gown: short black hair with a blue sheen and a thin small braid on each side of her face, dark red eyes, a long high-necked gown. Her right hand is lifted a little, and a single briar that had reached for her wrist is curling back away from it; her left hand rests at her waist. Rose petals and chandelier sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：舞会才开场满堂宾客叫蔷薇藤缠住，中了诅咒的铠甲舞者还在转。莉拉二十岁，银弩，名单折着塞在靴筒里。血月不写月字，写成红的夜空。老伯爵的手杖没画（不点破）。
